completion_mode: deterministic fallback after two OpenAI Responses API connections reset
transport_note: The live impact stage did not return a complete response. This fallback uses the pipeline's already-collected official H1, Q3, and Q4 evidence and the same deterministic EPS bridge rules; it does not use post-cutoff information.

forecast_basis.Net fees: FY25 H2 net fees are FY25 net fees of GBP972.4m less H1 FY25 GBP496.0m, or GBP476.4m. Approximate Q3/Q4 seasonality of 49.5%/50.5% is adjusted by the subsequently reported actual-currency declines of 7% and 4%, then added to reported H1 FY26 GBP453.3m: 453.3 + 476.4 x (49.5% x 93% + 50.5% x 96%) = GBP903.6m.
forecast_basis.Pre-exceptional operating profit: Hays said on 10 July that FY26 pre-exceptional operating profit was expected at the top of the GBP37m-GBP46m company-compiled consensus range. The central forecast is therefore GBP46.0m.
forecast_basis.Pre-exceptional basic EPS: Derived rather than directly predicted: (GBP46.0m operating profit - GBP13.0m net finance charge) x (1 - 45% tax rate) / 1,595.7m weighted-average shares x 100 pence per pound = 1.1374p. Finance-cost and tax inputs are H1 management guidance; the share count is the H1 reported basic weighted average.
